scope: Barcode compiler formulas and hard-gate invariants
Taxonomic status versus publication/export status separation
GSEG/GSIG claim-state viability as represented in generated evidence packs
non_claim_boundaries: This is an internal formula-consistency and fail-closed check over supplied inputs.
It is not an empirical species-delimitation validation over global biodiversity.
It is not a claim that GBIF occurrence context upgrades molecular evidence.

method_boundary: The audit checks internal formula consistency for supplied evidence and frozen gates.
It does not prove absolute species truth outside the supplied reference context.
It does not infer presence, absence, abundance, distribution, phenotype or function without external evidence.
Reference completeness remains a visible caveat when no external reference-coverage audit is attached.
